claims: "including sabbatical year calculations and the priestly watches" - The description implies the teacher explores these as separate topics, but the transcript shows the teacher only discusses these as specific details within the analysis of the Baraita regarding the destruction of the Bet HaMikdash.
summary: Rabbi Hidary examines the halakhic question of whether the Leviim must sing during a standalone wine libation offering on the Mizbeach. He then explores the historical baraita detailing the shared circumstances of the destruction of both the first and second Bet HaMikdash on Tisha BeAb, including sabbatical year calculations and the priestly watches.
questions: Do the Leviim sing when a wine libation is brought by itself without an animal?
Why was a specific psalm sung on the day the first Bet HaMikdash was destroyed?
How do we calculate the years of the Shemitah and Yovel cycles in relation to the destruction of the Bet HaMikdash?
Was the second Bet HaMikdash destroyed in the year following the Shemitah?
How were the priestly watches reconstituted after the return from Babylonia?
